description: I'm Gary Hutchins, and after 30 years with a municipal fire department in a small Midwestern town, this channel is where I cut through the fear and the sales pitch. From cheap, old-school habits that keep a fire from ever starting, to honest verdicts on the smoke detectors, extinguishers, space heaters and gadgets actually worth your money. Whether you live alone, look after an aging parent, or just want your house to be the one the fire department never has to visit, there's something here for you.
